message.content:
Based on my search, here are the main ways to pay your federal taxes online:

## 1. IRS Direct Pay (Free)
**Best for:** Individual taxpayers with a U.S. bank account

- **Website:** [directpay.irs.gov](https://directpay.irs.gov)
- **Cost:** Completely free
- **How it works:** Pay directly from your checking or savings account
- **Features:**
  - No registration or account required
  - Schedule payments up to 365 days in advance
  - Same-day payment option available
  - Change or cancel up to 2 business days before scheduled date
  - Instant confirmation
- **Limitations:** Limited to 2 payments per day; requires U.S. bank account with routing number

## 2. IRS Online Account
**Best for:** Taxpayers who want payment tracking and account management

- **Website:** [irs.gov/payments/your-online-account](https://www.irs.gov/payments/your-online-account)
- **Cost:** Free for bank account (ACH) payments
- **Features:**
  - View your tax balance and payment history
  - Make payments
  - Set up payment plans
  - Requires ID verification to create account

## 3. Debit or Credit Card
**Best for:** Those without U.S. bank accounts or who want to use card rewards

- **Authorized processors:** Pay1040 and ACI Payments, Inc.
- **Cost:** 
  - Debit card: ~$2.10–$2.15 flat fee
  - Credit card: 1.75%–1.85% of payment amount (minimum $2.50)
- **How it works:** Pay through third-party processor websites; they send payment to IRS
- **Note:** The IRS does not charge the fee—the payment processors do

## 4. Electronic Funds Withdrawal (EFW)
**Best for:** Those e-filing their tax return

- **Cost:** Generally free (check with your bank)
- **How it works:** Available when you e-file through tax software, IRS Free File, or a tax professional
- **Features:** Schedule payment when filing; can schedule up to 365 days in advance for estimated taxes

## 5. Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS)
**Best for:** Businesses and existing users

- **Website:** [eftps.gov](https://www.eftps.gov)
- **Cost:** Free
- **Important change:** As of October 17, 2025, EFTPS no longer accepts new individual enrollments. Existing users can continue using it.

## 6. IRS2Go Mobile App
**Best for:** Mobile users

- **Cost:** Free app; Direct Pay is free, card payments have processor fees
- **Features:** Make payments via mobile, check refund status, find free tax help

## Recent Important Change

A March 2025 Executive Order requires federal tax payments to be made electronically starting after September 30, 2025. Paper checks and money orders will no longer be accepted for most taxpayers.

**Exceptions:** Individuals without banking access, emergency situations, or those qualifying for other legal exemptions.

## Quick Comparison

| Method | Cost | Requires Registration | Best For |
|--------|------|---------------------|----------|
| IRS Direct Pay | Free | No | Simple, one-time payments |
| IRS Online Account | Free | Yes | Ongoing account management |
| Debit Card | ~$2.15 | No | Small payments, no bank account |
| Credit Card | 1.75-1.85% | No | Rewards points, flexibility |
| EFW | Free | No | When e-filing return |

---

**Sources:**
1. https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/tax-payments/how-to-pay-taxes-10-ways-to-pay-your-tax-bill/L6CR274jr
2. https://fiscal.treasury.gov/payments-to-government/electronic-federal-tax-payment-system-eftps
3. https://www.taxesforexpats.com/articles/expat-tax-rules/how-to-pay-taxes-online.html
4. https://www.nerdwallet.com/taxes/learn/pay-irs-options
5. https://www.zinnerco.com/zinner-blog/executive-order-requires-electronic-payment-of-federal-tax
6. https://www.taxbuddy.com/blog/advance-tax-payment-online
7. https://www.linkedin.com/posts/nasir-ahmed-922b342a5_usa-payroll-tax-payment-to-irs-using-quickbooks-activity-7265717672586153986-KKR3
8. https://www.tax1099.com/irs/irs-federal-tax-payment/
